title: Soil & Composting: Soil Friends
welcome_lead: Bacteria, fungi and worms are tiny gardeners doing huge work.
meta_desc: KS3 environmental science: soil life, mycorrhiza, worms.

concepts.def: Mushrooms and threads that recycle waste.

walkthroughs.body_html: Billions of bacteria and fungi per spoonful of soil break dead material into nutrients.
Many plants partner with mycorrhiza — fungal threads that bring minerals to roots in exchange for sugar. A hidden internet of life.
Earthworms mix soil layers, swallow dead leaves and leave nutrient-rich casts. Charles Darwin called them 'nature's ploughs'.
